# Huzaifa Sabah Uddin (Hexz) — Backend Developer & System Architect

> Backend developer portfolio of Huzaifa Sabah Uddin (Hexz) — Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Celery & Redis systems that replace enterprise tool stacks, saving $15.6K/year.

I build production-grade backend systems and REST APIs. Multi-tenant Django engines, async Celery pipelines, microservices, and custom SaaS infrastructure that replaces expensive enterprise tools. Based in Karachi, Pakistan — open to remote work worldwide.

## Projects

- Project Management & Workflow Engine: Multi-tenant Django PM platform serving 4 client organisations. Replaced Basecamp, Asana, Trello, Slack bots, and spreadsheets. Saves $15,600/year. Stack: Django, PostgreSQL, PgBouncer, Celery, Redis, Slack API, S3, Railway. (https://production.topsoftdigitals.pk/)
- IBM SkillsBuild Simulation Platform: Full-stack Java 17 + Spring Boot simulation platform with Hibernate ORM and MySQL. Led team of 5 as Scrum Master to 2nd place nationally. (https://github.com/Iamhuzaifasabahuddin/Group37App)
- Blink Digitally Publishing Dashboard: Streamlit dashboard (~6,000 LOC) saving editorial team 12+ hours/week. Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib/Seaborn, Google Sheets API, Slack bot. (https://github.com/Iamhuzaifasabahuddin/BlinkDigitally)
- Blink Digitally Ticket Management: End-to-end ticket system processing 200+ active tickets. Streamlit, Pandas, NumPy, Notion API, GitHub Actions cron. Reduced overdue items by 40%. (https://blinkdigitallytickets.streamlit.app/)
- Cafe 1947 Website & Booking System: Real-time booking engine replacing manual phone/paper system. Streamlit, Notion API, HTML/CSS, JavaScript. (https://www.cafe-1947.com/)
